mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, turn_no, task_id, user_content, assistant_content, status, compression_level, user_token_estimate, assistant_token_estimate, final_model_call_id, error_code, error_message, finish_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.conversation_id, t.turn_no, t.task_id, t.user_content, t.assistant_content, t.status, t.compression_level, t.user_token_estimate, t.assistant_token_estimate, t.final_model_call_id, t.error_code, t.error_message, t.finish_time, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM conversation_turn t INNER JOIN agent_conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND t.task_id = #{taskId}
